# Sentra Brain — Community Fair-Use Terms

**Maintainer:** Juan G. Carmona (individual).  
**Source License:** AGPL-3.0 (see `LICENSE`).  
These terms clarify fair-use for the **Community Edition** and when **commercial contact** is required.

## 1) What you can do (Community Edition)
- **Self-host** locally or in your private cloud.
- **Evaluate** and **develop** with Sentra Brain for personal projects, demos, PoCs, and internal trials.
- **Modify** the code and contribute improvements (respecting AGPL-3.0).

## 2) Free tier for organizations (5 seats)
Organizations may use Sentra Brain internally for **non-paid trials or limited internal use** with up to:
- **5 named user seats** per organization (total, not concurrent).
- **1 production instance** (plus any number of dev/test instances).

> **If you need more than 5 seats, multiple production instances, or broader operational use, please get in touch to arrange a commercial license.**

## 3) When commercial terms are required
You (or your employer/client) must contact the maintainer to obtain a commercial license if **any** of the following apply:
- Use **beyond 5 named users** inside an organization.
- **Ongoing production** use by a company (beyond limited internal trial/evaluation).
- **Paid services** offered to third parties **using Sentra Brain** as a backend or capability.
- **Redistribution** of Sentra Brain as part of a product or managed service.

Commercial terms enable: additional seats, assisted support/SLAs, certified hardware profiles, and optional features.

## 4) Activation (optional, future)
A lightweight activation may provide an **anonymous Instance ID** for license validation and update eligibility.  
- Exchanged data: **license + version metadata only**.  
- **No application content or user data** is transmitted.

## 5) Attribution and compliance
- Keep copyright notices and license headers intact.
- If you modify and deploy, AGPL-3.0 **requires offering source code** to users interacting with the software over a network.

## 6) Seat definition
A **seat** is a named person with access to the platform (directly or via integrated apps). Service accounts for automation don’t count as seats but must be proportionate to the deployment.

## 7) Termination
If you exceed fair-use (e.g., seat limits) without a commercial license, you must **cease production use** or **regularize** your license.

## 8) Contact
For commercial licensing or questions: **hello@sentrabrain.com** (or the contact form at **https://sentrabrain.com**).
